recipe.visualDefinition: A surreal, mythological scene featuring an anthropomorphic feline figure with a cat's head and a human-like body performing a traditional dance atop a cluster of multiple black cobras. The figure is dressed in vibrant orange and yellow traditional attire, set against a deep blue atmospheric background, framed by an ornate golden-brown border with intricate filigree.
coreVisualRelationships: The central figure is vertically aligned, balancing on the heads of a multi-headed serpent base.
The dark, scaly texture of the snakes contrasts with the smooth, bright fabric of the dancer's clothing.
The deep blue background provides a high-contrast backdrop for the warm-toned figure and the golden border.
coreInvariants: A cat-headed humanoid dancer in a dynamic pose.
A base composed of multiple intertwined black cobras with visible scales.
A thick, decorative border featuring repeating circular and floral motifs.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The feline dancer is the central vertical focal point, occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The mass of snake bodies at the bottom provides a heavy, dark foundation for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the upward reach of the dancer's arm toward the top-right emblem, then down through the snake heads.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The blue sky area provides breathing room around the complex central figures.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Saffron Orange and Marigold Yellow (Dancer's Attire)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central figure against a moody, desaturated dark blue sky.

letterConstructionRules: Fluid, hand-drawn cursive for the title text.
Thick-to-thin stroke variation suggesting a brush or quill.
The emblem text is integrated into a winged, circular graphic device.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature exaggerated swashes and loops.
Lowercase letters are tightly connected with high-contrast weights.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly stylized, graphic emblem paired with a more traditional, readable calligraphic script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, warped style of the top emblem.
Approximates the elegant, hand-written feel of the title text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Paint a surreal scene of a cat-headed humanoid dancer in orange and yellow Indian-style clothing, balancing on a cluster of black cobras. Use a deep blue sky background. Surround the entire image with a thick, ornate golden-brown border featuring repeating circular filigree patterns. Leave the top right and bottom right areas clear for graphic overlays.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a winged circular emblem in the top right corner with stylized, warped lettering inside. Add a small rectangular parchment box in the bottom right containing elegant, hand-drawn calligraphic script.

verificationChecks: Is the cat head realistically rendered but on a humanoid body?
Are there exactly nine or more cobra heads visible?
Is the border pattern consistent and ornate?
Does the color palette maintain the warm-against-cool contrast?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue background gradient

mustAchieve: Intricate detail in the snake scales and border

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the dancer's pose feels balanced and dynamic.
Check that the snake scales have a consistent, rhythmic texture.
Verify the border does not overlap the central subject.
Confirm the winged emblem feels integrated into the overall composition.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Mythological Subject] with [Animal Hybrid] in a [Traditional Dance Pose] set against a [High Contrast Atmospheric Background] framed by an [Ornate Filigree Border] with [Graphic Emblem Overlays].
